nodes.speaker: log_staff
nodes.text: HOLDING, SHIFT NOTE. Holding 03 stays empty. If its door shows a fault, log it and walk away.

nodes.speaker: log_staff
nodes.text: Do not open it to check. Records says there is nobody in there.

nodes.speaker: log_subject
nodes.text: (Scratched inside a panel.) If you're reading this, you woke up too. They take the number off the door first. Then the file. Then you.

nodes.speaker: log_subject
nodes.text: Go up. Every floor up is a floor they didn't plan for.

nodes.speaker: log_staff
nodes.text: RECORDS, PURGE QUEUE. Batch 7 purged: twelve subject files. Subjects accounted for: eleven.

nodes.speaker: log_staff
nodes.text: I flagged the mismatch. I was told to stop flagging the mismatch.

nodes.speaker: log_subject
nodes.text: (Written on the back of a specimen tag.) The voice on the intercom is kind until you stop listening. Then it starts counting.

nodes.speaker: log_subject
nodes.text: I counted the lifts. Only the freight one goes all the way up.

nodes.speaker: log_staff
nodes.text: LABS, INCIDENT 41. A subject from Holding reached the Specimen Hall before lockdown. Freight shutter sealed from this side.

nodes.speaker: log_staff
nodes.text: Someone on the other side kept knocking. Nobody here would say who.
